usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: The token ledger's daily rollup (usage_daily): what every tenant, agent and model spent on a UTC day. It is the figure quotas and agent budgets are enforced against.
usage.meta: {day} (UTC) · {slices, plural, one {# slice} other {# slices}} · {tenants, plural, one {# tenant} other {# tenants}}
usage.emptyGuidance: Every LLM call through a metered agent is recorded here. Pick another day, or chat with an agent and refresh.
usage.footnote: Billable = input + output, the rule quotas and budgets use. Per-call detail lives on each profile under Users when usage.events is on.
